content.short: GobFam is a one-of-a-kind community oriented asset-backed deflationary NFT art collection on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
GobFam is a one-of-a-kind asset-backed deflationary NFT art collection featuring 300 unique Goblin characters called GOBs on the Cardano Blockchain. In GobFam, a deflationary mechanism is designed to reduce the circulating supply of GOBs with time. 20% of Season 1 GOBs sales will also be transferred into the treasury where every GOB is backed by the asset (ADA).

As GobFam, we seek to create and promote a healthy NFT community where the needs and wants of our community is prioritized. With this goal, the GobTeam has designed multiple plans and mechanisms that focuses on benefit the community at large in the long-run.
